name: settings-template
title: Settings
description: Structure for a settings or form page: a header, then card sections of labelled fields in one column.
docs: A template from MACAW 0.2.0. Components come from @macaw-ds/ui and stay on the upgrade path; this composition is yours to edit.

block.name: Settings
block.purpose: Structure for a settings or form page: a header, then card sections of labelled fields in one column.
block.description: A PageHeader, then a single column capped at max-w-form of Card sections, each a labelled region with a title, a description, labelled Inputs with optional hints and a CardFooter with its Save button. One primary per page: the last section's Save is primary and earlier sections' are secondary. Renders the main area only.
whenToUse: Account, business, payout or notification settings.
Any form that splits into a few independently saved groups.
whenNotToUse: A multi-step flow such as onboarding: one step per page with its own primary action.
A record with actions: use the record template.
rules: Render inside AppShell's main; never add a second main or a TopBar.
The PageHeader title is the page's only h1; section titles are h2.
Every Input has a visible label via Text as label with htmlFor; hints are linked with aria-describedby.
Only one primary Button on the page: the last section's Save.
Field ids are unique on the page.
